user.title: NEC phone system
user.description: Connects to the SMDR (call log) port of an NEC SL2100 or SV9100. The port is set in Program 10-20 (external equipment 5, SMDR Output); 4001 is the Australian default.

data_description.host: IP address of the phone system's NET port, e.g. 192.168.0.10.
data_description.port: Program 10-20, type 5. Only one program can hold this port at a time.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect. Check the address, that SMDR output is set to LAN (Program 35-01-01) and that no other call logger is connected.

abort.already_configured: This phone system is already set up.

init.title: Rooms, lines, phonebook and FreePBX
init.description: One entry per line as `number: name`. Each extension and line listed gets its own device. The FreePBX fields are optional: fill them in to see calls ringing live and to switch do-not-disturb.

data.date_order: Date order in the call log

data_description.phonebook: For example `0491570156: Alex`. Used to put names on calls.
data_description.date_order: How your phone system prints dates. Automatic works it out from each call; pick one if your dates look wrong.
data_description.lines: Trunk number to name, for example `001: Main line`. Shown on the call log as the line number.
data_description.ami_host: Optional. The FreePBX IP address, for live ringing and caller ID. Leave empty to turn it off.
data_description.ami_user: A manager user from FreePBX: Settings > Asterisk Manager Users. It needs read access to call and system, and write access to system for do-not-disturb.
data_description.dnd_extensions: FreePBX extensions that get a do-not-disturb switch, comma separated, for example `901, 902`.

error.bad_mapping: Every line needs a colon, like `103: Oliver`.
error.ami_auth: FreePBX rejected that manager user or password.
error.ami_cannot_connect: Couldn't reach the FreePBX manager at that address and port. Check the address, and that this Home Assistant is allowed under the manager user's Permit.

call_log_unreachable.title: {name}: call log not connected
call_log_unreachable.description:
Home Assistant hasn't been able to read the call log from the phone system at {address} for over 10 minutes (last error: {error}).

Calls made in the meantime aren't lost: the phone system keeps them and sends them when the connection comes back. Check that the phone system is on, that its address hasn't changed, and that no other program (such as call-logging software) is connected to the SMDR port. This message clears itself once the call log reconnects.
